_how: Print exports/print/calibration-9cm.png exactly as you print cards, then read the grid (in page mm) at each edge of the blank card. cardOnPageMm is the card's box on the page; rotate says how the card lies on it. npm run export:print places every card there.
_measured: 2026-09-23 from a photo of the calibration print: the printer turns the page so the card's top sits along the page's left side, and scales it up about 5.5%.
